# Your Daily Briefing — Sunday 26 October

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training session logged and just 6,392 steps, which is fairly low activity overall. You burned 2,522 kcal though, which actually puts you close to your 2,300 kcal target — just watch that you're hitting your 175g protein to protect muscle while in a deficit.

Your recovery markers are flashing amber. HRV at 66ms is well below your 98-120ms baseline, and combined with only 6.3 hours of sleep and a stress score of 58/100, your body is telling you it's struggling to recover. If you have a session planned today, dial the intensity back — a gentle 20-30 minute easy run or walk is plenty.

Tonight, prioritise sleep above everything else. Aim for 8 hours — HRV responds quickly to extra rest, and getting that number back towards baseline will make next week's training far more productive. 🏃
